{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to only the treatment arm
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the response fraction
response_fraction = treatment_only['responded'].mean()

# Print the exact values used in the evidence
print(f"response_fraction: {response_fraction}")
print(f"treatment_only.shape: {treatment_only.shape}")"}
